facts.title: Steel-Cut Oat "Risotto" with Butternut Squash and Kale
ingredients: 1 small (2 pounds) butternut squash or 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and diced into ½” cubes
1 teaspoon salt, divided, more to taste
2 packed cups chopped kale, ribs removed (about ½ bunch)
¾ cup (1 ¾ ounces) freshly grated Parmesan cheese
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
